title: Extra fields
summary: Adding your own fields to customers, jobs, invoices and tickets.
html:
Extra fields add your own information to records that already exist. An account reference on a customer, a purchase order number on an invoice, a serial number on a ticket.

Adding one

Extra fields are configured per record type under Settings. Give the field a name and a type, and it appears on that record's edit form.

A field can be set to show in the list screen as a column, and in some areas it becomes searchable, so an account reference is a field you can actually look a customer up by.

Where the values can be used

Extra field values can be pulled into templates — an invoice email quoting the customer's own purchase order number, for instance. The template edit screen lists the variables available.

Flags

Some extra fields have special meaning rather than just holding a value. A flag field marks records in the list, which is a cheap way to maintain your own status that the product does not have a concept of.

Settings

  • hide_extra hides extra fields from screens where they would otherwise show.
  • accounts_extra_field_name nominates the field holding an accounting system reference, for installations that export to one.

When to use custom data instead

If you find yourself adding six extra fields that only make sense together, you probably want a custom data form instead.
